extensionName: Hardware Bus, Audio & Input Controller Pack

newBlocks.tooltip: Triggers a hardware key scanning array cycle pass and buffers active hardware bits straight into the main register.
Carves out an 8-slot selection pointer index layout in safe calculator RAM to track active player inventory slots.
Checks if number keys (1-8) are tapped to instantly overwrite the active inventory item pointer variable.
Evaluates two hardware input signals simultaneously, branching to target pins only if both buttons are held at the same clock tick.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld a, (CachedHardwareInputBits)
and {BitmaskKeyA}
ld b, a
ld a, (CachedHardwareInputBits)
and {BitmaskKeyB}
and b
jr z, _MultiKeyConditionFailed

newBlocks.tooltip: Hooks into the hardware bus timer to selectively freeze active physics and AI threads while keeping the UI running.
Generates a direct square-wave sound frequency pulse through the 2.5mm link port jack pins.
Triggers a rapid procedural white-noise frequency explosion sound layout effect sequence.
Recalibrates the calculator’s onboard crystal timer interrupt rate to drive chiptune tracker data streams accurately.
Halts active processing script operations and counts clock ticks straight from the calculator’s onboard hardware crystal timer before returning control.
Sets up a secure execution wrapper to launch encrypted sequel binaries using a centralized data AppVar file.
